title: Dyson Daniels Salary: Converting Hourly Rates to Annual Pay the Australian Way
description: Learn how to convert hourly pay to annual salary using the Dyson Daniels salary formula. Understand 38-hour weeks, fortnightly pay, tax, and super with Fair Work guidelines.
salarySummary: The Dyson Daniels salary conversion uses hourly rate × 38 hours × 52 weeks to estimate annual gross pay, then applies tax and super.

faqs.q: How do I convert my hourly rate to an annual salary?
faqs.a: Multiply your hourly rate by the number of hours you work each week, then by 52. For a standard full-time role, assume 38 hours per week. For example, $30 per hour × 38 hours × 52 weeks = $59,280 gross per year. This formula does not include overtime, penalties, or allowances. Use [the timesheet](/) for a personalised calculation.

faqs.q: What is casual loading and how does it affect my pay?
faqs.a: Casual loading is an extra 25% on top of the base hourly rate to compensate for not receiving paid leave. From 1 July 2026, the casual National Minimum Wage is $33.05 per hour (base $26.44 plus 25%). When using a calculator, never enter a rate that already includes casual loading; instead, check the box to add it automatically. See [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading) for more.

faqs.q: How is superannuation calculated on my annual salary?
faqs.a: Superannuation guarantee is 12% of your ordinary earnings, paid by your employer on top of your gross pay. The maximum contribution base is $270,830 per year. For example, on a $59,280 salary, super would be $7,113.60 per year. Super is not deducted from your pay; it is an additional contribution. Learn about [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging).

bodyMarkdown:
## The Basic Formula: Hourly × Hours per Week × 52

Converting an hourly rate to an annual salary is straightforward: multiply your hourly rate by the number of hours you work each week, then by 52 weeks. This gives your gross annual pay before tax and super. For example, if you earn $30 per hour and work 38 hours a week, your annual gross is $30 × 38 × 52 = $59,280. This formula assumes consistent hours and no unpaid overtime, penalty rates, or allowances. For a precise calculation, use [the timesheet](/).

Whether you're calculating your own pay or curious about a high-profile figure like the Dyson Daniels salary, the same conversion applies. The Dyson Daniels salary, while not publicly detailed in hourly terms, can be understood through this framework if his contract were expressed as an hourly rate.

## Why 38 Hours Is the Standard

The Fair Work Ombudsman defines the standard full-time week as 38 hours. The National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour, which equates to $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours. This 38-hour week is the baseline for most award classifications. When you see a salary figure, it’s often based on this assumption. The Fair Work Ombudsman’s [pay guides](/blog) provide minimum rates for each award, including weekly and fortnightly equivalents.

## Fortnightly Pay: A Handy Check

Many Australian employers pay fortnightly. To find your fortnightly gross, simply multiply your weekly pay by two. Using the $30 per hour example, weekly pay is $1,140, so fortnightly is $2,280. This helps when budgeting or comparing with salary offers that quote a fortnightly figure. The Fair Work Ombudsman’s Pay and Conditions Tool () can also show fortnightly amounts for your award.

## National Minimum Wage and Award Rates

From 1 July 2026, the National Minimum Wage increased to $26.44 per hour or $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours. Award minimum wages rose by 4.75%. These rates are set by the Fair Work Commission and enforced by the Fair Work Ombudsman. If you are covered by an award, your minimum pay must meet or exceed the award rate. The [reference tables](/data) on this site list current award rates. Always check your specific award using the pay guides from the Fair Work Ombudsman.

### Annualised Wages and Salaries

Some awards allow annualised wages, where a fixed amount covers minimum pay, penalties, overtime, allowances, and annual leave loading. The Fair Work Ombudsman explains that an annualised wage must not be less than what the employee would have received under the award. Employers must review the arrangement every 12 months or when employment ends. This is different from a salary under an employment contract, which may offset entitlements. For more, see annualised wages and salaries on the Fair Work Ombudsman site.

## Casual Loading and Superannuation

Casual employees receive a 25% loading on top of the base hourly rate. For the National Minimum Wage, that means $33.05 per hour. This loading compensates for lack of paid leave. When using a calculator, never enter a rate that already includes casual loading; instead, use a checkbox to add it. Superannuation guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings, paid on top of your gross pay. The maximum contribution base is $270,830 per year. So if your annual salary is below that, super is calculated on your full ordinary earnings. For example, on $59,280 gross, super would be $7,113.60 per year, paid by your employer. Learn more about [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging).

## Tax and Medicare: What to Expect

Resident tax rates for 2026–27 are: nil on the first $18,200, 15% on income between $18,201 and $45,000, 30% on $45,001 to $135,000, 37% on $135,001 to $190,000, and 45% above $190,000. Medicare levy is generally 2% of taxable income. Using the $59,280 example, tax would be approximately $9,767 plus Medicare $1,185.60, leaving around $48,327 after tax. This is an estimate; your actual tax may vary. Use the [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) calculator for a personalised estimate.

## Putting It All Together: The Dyson Daniels Salary Example

While we don’t have the exact Dyson Daniels salary figure, the conversion method applies to any hourly rate. If his NBA contract were expressed as an hourly rate, you could multiply by 38 and 52 to get an annual equivalent. However, professional athletes often have different pay structures. For most Australian workers, the formula remains: hourly rate × hours per week × 52. Always check your award or agreement for the correct classification. The [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) page provides more examples.

Remember, this estimate assumes no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is paid on top and capped at the maximum contribution base. For a full picture, consult the Fair Work Ombudsman’s pay guides and the Australian Taxation Office for tax specifics.
